company.name: Retell AI
company.shortDescription: Retell AI is the AI voice platform that helps corporate call centers automate calls indistinguishable from human.
company.description: Retell AI is the AI voice platform that helps corporate call centers automate calls indistinguishable from human. Retell's platform reduces labor costs, improves first-call resolution, and frees up human agents to focus on complex or sensitive issues. With rapid no-code deployment and high configurability, enterprises can launch Retell's fully automated voice agents in days—not months. Retell serves thousands of businesses and now powers 10+ million minutes of phone conversations every month.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for building, testing, deploying, and managing LLM-based voice agents that conduct inbound and outbound phone conversations and execute business tasks.

productsAndServices.description: A visual agent-building environment for designing multi-step call flows with branching logic, guardrails, reusable components, tools, and controlled handoffs.

productsAndServices.description: An AI scheduling solution that handles appointment booking, confirmations, rescheduling, reminders, intake, and lead qualification across phone, chat, SMS, and web channels.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-based call center solution for automating routine inbound and outbound interactions, routing callers, resolving requests, and escalating complex cases to human agents.
productsAndServices.name: Retell AI Call Center Automation

productsAndServices.description: Tools for transcribing, analyzing, scoring, and monitoring voice and chat interactions to evaluate agent performance and identify operational issues.
productsAndServices.name: Retell AI Post Call Analysis and AI Quality Assurance

productsAndServices.description: Telephony services and APIs for connecting AI agents to phone numbers and communication channels, including SIP trunking, batch calling, branded caller ID, verified numbers, chat, SMS, and WebRTC.
